stages.work: One bounded qualification attempt on at most 500 eligible contexts; cheap candidate model plus independent Kimi comparison and at most 100 Astra adjudications.
stages.output: Per-field evidence checks, machine-reference agreement, unknown rates and measured token/latency/failure profile; no human QA.

stages.work: Only if step3 qualifies the proposed fields, process up to 10000 truly missing eligible contexts for incremental production and throughput measurement.

stages.work: In parallel, develop the existing paper draft and compatible macro/micro tables from reused data; preserve proxy and causal limits.

stages.work: Release measured missing-field production by bounded tranche; no new training/GPU, no full-text rerun by default.
stages.output: Full target remains unchanged; itemized true remaining cost and schedule from the qualified workload.
stages.gate: Need verified eligible unique count by field, qualified route, measured throughput and verified funds; no automatic full expansion.

tranche_scope: Steps1-5 only; caps are proposed, not purchased, reserved or automatically enforced by Azure. Stop job admission before caps; maintain separate existing-resource baseline costs.
